[[Symbol of Control]] is a {{rarity|masterwork|masterwork}} [[crafting material]] rarely obtained by [[Salvage|salvaging]] [[sigil]]s or from the [[Mystic Forge]].

== Acquisition ==
=== Salvaged from ===
{{salvaged from}}

=== Recipe ===
Combining any three [[Symbol (ingredient)|Symbols]] with a [[Philosopher's Stone]] will yield a random symbol. There is a higher chance to obtain a symbol not used in the recipe, and a lower chance to receive a symbol used in the forge.
{{Recipe
| source = Mystic Forge
| ingredient1 = 1 Symbol (ingredient)
| ingredient2 = 1 Symbol (ingredient)
| ingredient3 = 1 Symbol (ingredient)
| ingredient4 = 1 Philosopher's Stone
| base ingredients calculation = n
}}

== Used in ==
=== Random Upgrade Components ===
There is also Mystic Forge recipe that grants random Superior Sigils.
{{Recipe
| name = Random Superior Sigil
| source = Mystic Forge
| quantity = 1
| ingredient1 = 10 Pile of Lucent Crystal
| ingredient2 = 1 Symbol of Control
| ingredient3 = 1 Symbol of Enhancement
| ingredient4 = 1 Symbol of Pain
| status = historical <!-- this will prevent the recipe from storing semantic properties -->
}}

{{recipe list by discipline}}
